class.name: PlantSpecies
class.brief_description: One kind of plant: its meshes, spacing and the ground it grows on.
class.description: Describes a plant for [VegetationField3D]: mesh variants, how far apart plants stand, how much room they keep from other species, and rules over the [TerrainDataMap3D] maps (slope, height, curvature, wetness, water depth, distance to water). Each rule is a range with a soft edge: a plant is kept with probability [member density] times the product of every rule's weight at its point. The defaults keep every plant on dry land; a water plant widens [member water_depth_range].

method.name: get_patch_weight
method.description: Returns the patch weight at [param global_position], from 0 (between patches) to 1 (inside one). Always 1 when [member patch_scale] is 0.

method.name: get_rule_fade
method.description: Returns the soft edge of a rule, see [method set_rule_fade].

method.name: get_rule_range
method.description: Returns the range of a rule, see [method set_rule_range].

method.name: get_suitability_at
method.description: Returns the product of every rule's weight at [param global_position] on a baked [TerrainDataMap3D], from 0 (cannot grow here) to 1.

method.name: rule_weight
method.description: Returns the weight of [param value] against [param rule]: 1 inside the range, falling to 0 over the fade (smoothstep), 0 beyond.

method.name: set_rule_fade
method.description: Sets the soft edge of a rule, in the rule's units: the weight falls from 1 to 0 over this distance outside the range. 0 is a hard edge.

method.name: set_rule_range
method.description: Sets the range (min, max) of a rule in its units, see [enum Rule].

members.member: How far the plant tilts from upright towards the ground normal: 0 upright (trees, reeds), 1 along the slope (ground cover).
Soft edge of [member aridity_range].

Aridity index (annual precipitation over potential evapotranspiration, Thornthwaite) where the species grows: below 0.5 is dry steppe, above 1 humid. Ignored when the map has no climate ([method TerrainDataMap3D.bake_climate]).

If [code]true[/code], this species' crown is needle-leaved (pine, spruce, fir, larch). [VegetationField3D] counts each crown's share of the cover overhead, so the floor under it can follow the stand type through [member conifer_range].
Share of the light this species' crown stops under its core, for [member canopy_radius]. A broadleaf crown in summer stops about 0.85 to 0.95, a pine or birch less.

Crown radius in metres (times each plant's scale). Above 0 the species shades the ground under it, and later species in the [Biome] with a [member shade_range] are placed by that shade (see [method VegetationField3D.get_shade_at]).
Fade width outside [member conifer_range].

Share of the canopy overhead that is needle-leaved where this species grows, from [code]0.0[/code] (broadleaf: beech, oak) to [code]1.0[/code] (conifer: spruce, pine), from crowns with [member canopy_conifer] placed earlier by the same [VegetationField3D]. Open ground counts as [code]0.0[/code].
Soft edge of [member curvature_range].
Ground curvature range in 1/m: positive in hollows and valley floors, negative on ridges.
Fraction of the Poisson-disk points kept where every rule is fully met, from 0 to 1.

The plant seen from far above (rgb) and how much of the ground it hides (alpha, 0 to 1). Beyond its [member visibility_range] the plants are thinned away, and [VegetationField3D] bakes this colour into the ground's [code]vegetation_far_map[/code] where they grew, so a stand of them stays a patch of their colour to the horizon (see [method VegetationField3D.get_floor_shader_code]). Alpha 0 leaves the ground as it is.

If [code]true[/code], plants sit level on the water surface ([method TerrainDataMap3D.get_water_depth_at] above the ground), as water lilies do. Pair it with a [member water_depth_range] that starts above zero.
Radius in metres that later species in the [Biome] keep clear of (a trunk and its shade). 0 leaves room for anything.
Soft edge of [member height_range].
Ground height range in metres.
Soft edge of [member january_temperature_range].

January mean temperature in °C where the species grows: its frost hardiness, for example [code]Vector2(-3, 100)[/code] for beech, which stops where winters are much colder. Ignored when the map has no climate ([method TerrainDataMap3D.bake_climate]).
Soft edge of [member litter_range].

Range of leaf litter fallen from the crowns the plant may grow on ([method VegetationField3D.get_litter_at]): full under broad-leaved crowns, thinning over a few metres past their rim, so litter drifts into edges and clearings. Needle-leaved crowns drop none.
Mesh variants; each plant picks one at random. Plants carry ([code]variant, scale, random, species[/code]) in [code]INSTANCE_CUSTOM[/code] for their materials.
The channel of [member VegetationField3D.density_mask] that scales this species' density: 0 red, 1 green, 2 blue, 3 alpha; -1 ignores the mask.
If [code]true[/code], the species grows where the mask channel is low instead (one minus it), so a meadow can fill exactly the clearing that keeps trees out.

Heavier meshes drawn within [member near_range], one per entry of [member meshes] in the same order (a shorter list repeats). Each plant keeps its variant, so a tree with real needles near the camera and needle sprays beyond it stays the same tree. The field cuts such a species into cells about a quarter of [member near_range] across (at least 4 m), so the swap happens a few plants at a time, and crossfades the two over the last tenth of the range with a dither.
Passed to [member near_mesh_source]'s [code]request_near_mesh[/code], to say which plant's near meshes are wanted.

Near meshes on demand, for heavy meshes only plants that come near need: an object with [code]request_near_mesh(key: int, variant: int) -> Mesh[/code], returning [code]null[/code] while the mesh is still being built. Used when [member near_meshes] is empty and [member near_range] is above 0: [VegetationField3D] asks for each cell within 1.2 x [member near_range] of the camera every frame until it has the mesh, then draws it with the same crossfade as [member near_meshes], and frees the cell beyond 1.5 x, so the source can free meshes nothing draws. Only the object's id is kept: keep the source alive yourself.
Distance in metres within which [member near_meshes] are drawn instead of [member meshes]. 0 turns the swap off.
Fraction of the ground inside patches.

If [code]true[/code], the species grows between the patches instead. Two species with the same [member patch_scale], [member patch_cover] and [member patch_seed], one inverted, share the ground exactly (for example tall grass in patches and clover between them).
Size of the patches, in metres. The species then grows only in patches (clover beds, flower drifts, stands of tall grass), from value noise over the ground. 0 turns patches off.
Seed of the patch noise.
Soft edge of [member precipitation_range].
Annual precipitation in mm where the species grows. Ignored when the map has no climate ([method TerrainDataMap3D.bake_climate]).
If [code]true[/code], each plant turns to a random angle around its up axis.
Soft edge of [member rock_range].

Bare rock exposure (0 to 1) where the species grows, from the map's [member TerrainDataMap3D.geology_source]. Trees and most plants need little: for example [code]Vector2(0, 0.3)[/code]. Ignored when the map has no geology.
Each plant's uniform scale is picked between [code]x[/code] and [code]y[/code].
Soft edge of [member shade_range].

Canopy shade (0 open sky, 1 dense crown) where the species grows, from the canopy species placed before it by a [VegetationField3D]: for example [code]Vector2(0.4, 1)[/code] for bilberry, ferns and mosses, [code]Vector2(0, 0.3)[/code] for meadow plants. Ignored outside a [VegetationField3D] (a [GrassField3D] has no canopy).
Soft edge of [member slope_range], in degrees.
Ground slope range in degrees (0 is flat).
Soft edge of [member soil_depth_range], in metres.

Soil depth over bedrock (metres) where the species grows, from the map's [member TerrainDataMap3D.geology_source]. Trees need room to root, for example [code]Vector2(0.5, 100000)[/code]; grasses take thin soil. Ignored when the map has no geology.
Minimum distance in metres between two plants of this species (Poisson-disk radius).
Soft edge of [member sunlight_range].

Annual mean shortwave radiation at the ground in W/m², with slope, aspect and horizons: sun-loving species on south-facing slopes, shade-tolerant ones on north-facing. Ignored when the map has no climate ([method TerrainDataMap3D.bake_climate]).
Soft edge of [member spray_range].

Waterfall spray potential (0 to 1, [method TerrainDataMap3D.get_spray_at]) where the species grows. By default no plant grows in a fall's soaked zone, where only mosses and wet rock hold; mosses from [method PlantGenerator.make_floor] take [code]Vector2(0, 1)[/code]. Ignored when the map has no geology.
Soft edge of [member talus_range].
Scree cover (0 to 1) where the species grows, from the map's geology. Keep most species to [code]Vector2(0, 0.2)[/code]; a few scree specialists take more. Ignored when the map has no geology.
Soft edge of [member temperature_range].
Mean annual temperature in °C where the species grows; with the lapse rate it sets tree lines and altitude belts. Ignored when the map has no climate ([method TerrainDataMap3D.bake_climate]).

Distance, in metres, beyond which the species is not drawn. For ground cover too small to see far away. Plants with the generated plant material thin out before it: from 35% of the range the share drawn falls to none at the range, each plant shrinking away in the order of its placement rank while the rest grow slightly to hold the cover, so there are no pops; [member far_color] then carries them on the ground. 0 draws it at any distance.
Soft edge of [member water_depth_range], in metres.
Water depth range in metres; 0 is dry land. The default (0, 0) with a 5 cm fade keeps plants out of water.
Soft edge of [member water_distance_range], in metres.
Signed distance to the shoreline range in metres: positive on land, negative under water.
Soft edge of [member wetness_range].
Topographic wetness index range: about 4 to 7 on hillsides, 10 and above where water collects.

constants.constant: Signed distance to water in metres.
Soil depth over bedrock in metres (needs the map's geology).
Bare rock exposure, 0 to 1 (needs the map's geology).
Scree cover, 0 to 1 (needs the map's geology).
Annual mean shortwave at the ground, W/m² (climate).
Share of the canopy overhead that is needle-leaved, [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code].
Broad-leaf litter fallen from the crowns, [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code] ([method VegetationField3D.get_litter_at]).
